summary.text: Mercedes Narcisse is a registered nurse who represents the 46th District on the New York City Council, which includes Canarsie, Marine Park, Flatlands, Mill Basin and Sheepshead Bay in Brooklyn.
Her Council biography says she chairs the Committee on Hospitals and was re-elected in November 2025 to a term beginning January 1, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Narcisse was born in Saint Marc, Haiti, and migrated to the United States as a teenager, settling in Brooklyn, according to her Council biography.
She attended public high school in Brooklyn and is a CUNY graduate.
Before her election in November 2021 she worked as a registered nurse and was a small business owner.
The biography lists legislation she sponsored on health outcomes for people with sickle cell disease and on training NYPD officers to identify and interact with New Yorkers with autism.
She also serves on the Health, Education, Finance, Parks and Recreation, and Criminal Justice Committees and is the mother of four.
